whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.subtitle: The company's WhatsApp Business number, used by every module

whatsapp_settings.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp_settings.subtitle: Connect the company's WhatsApp Business number once. CRM, Finance, HR, Projects, Documents and Fleet all send from it.
whatsapp_settings.source_crm: Not set here yet. Modules are using the WhatsApp settings saved in CRM until this page is filled in.
whatsapp_settings.source_env: Not set here yet. Modules are using the server's default WhatsApp settings.
whatsapp_settings.source_none: WhatsApp is not connected. Messages are not sent until a number is set up here.
whatsapp_settings.display_number_hint: The number people see messages from, for reference.
whatsapp_settings.phone_number_id_hint: Meta → WhatsApp → API Setup. A long number, not the phone number itself.
whatsapp_settings.business_account_id_hint: Shown on the same API Setup page. Needed later for message templates.
whatsapp_settings.token_hint: A permanent System User token from Meta Business Settings. Temporary tokens expire after 24 hours.
whatsapp_settings.token_keep: Saved and encrypted. Leave blank to keep it, or paste a new one to replace it.
whatsapp_settings.country_code_hint: Added to local numbers such as 082 000 0000.
whatsapp_settings.remove_confirm: Remove the company's WhatsApp account? Modules fall back to CRM's WhatsApp settings, if any, and otherwise stop sending.
whatsapp_settings.test_hint: Sends Meta's “hello_world” template, which every new number has, so it works even if the recipient has never messaged you.
whatsapp_settings.where_1: Open business.facebook.com and choose your business.
whatsapp_settings.where_2: Go to WhatsApp Manager, then API Setup, and copy the Phone number ID.
whatsapp_settings.where_3: In Business Settings → System Users, create a user with WhatsApp permissions and generate a permanent token.
whatsapp_settings.where_4: Paste both here, save, and send a test.
whatsapp_settings.crm_fallback: A company that set WhatsApp up in CRM keeps working: CRM's settings are used only until this page is complete.

crm_settings_index.whatsapp_central: This company's WhatsApp number is set centrally, and CRM sends from it.
crm_settings_index.whatsapp_central_hint: Tip: set WhatsApp once in Settings → Structure → WhatsApp so every module can use it; CRM's own settings are used only until then.
